name: 044.4 — input: clicks land where they look like they land
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 044.4: a pointer put on a widget standing in the world arrives at the widget in its own pixels — MouseDown, MouseUp, MouseMove and Wheel, on both anchors and in all three facing modes — a button's callback runs, ev:preventDefault() still cancels, and a point on no panel is answered false so the world beneath keeps its click.
